entities.summary: Jay Robert Pritzker is an American politician, lawyer, and businessman serving since 2019 as the 43rd governor of Illinois. He is a member of the Democratic Party. JB Pritzker was a performers & entertainers from Atherton (b. 1965-01-19, Atherton). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
